landing.text:
HEADLINE
Maximize ROI

SUBHEADLINE
For B2B finance professionals, accurately track which SaaS tools their team uses.

WHAT THIS IS
An AI messaging workspace that turns rough product thinking into positioning, landing copy, and UX drafts.

WHO IT IS FOR
B2B finance professionals

THE PROBLEM
Inaccurate tracking of SaaS tool usage hinders ROI.

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets are inadequate for B2B finance professionals, forcing manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Automates tracking with existing accounting software integration.

KEY BENEFITS
Founders create clearer product narratives within the first brief report.

CALL TO ACTION
Start optimizing SaaS tool usage.

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
SaaS tool usage tracker for finance teams helps b2b finance professionals understand risk, complete KYC, and start their first investment with confidence.

ONBOARDING
1. Answer a few questions to understand your financial situation.
2. Complete your verification so SaaS tool usage tracker for finance teams can personalise your plan.
3. Start your first investment and track your progress.

EMPTY STATE
1. No risk profile yet. Complete the questionnaire to get started.
2. No investments set up yet. Finish setup to see your plan.
3. No transactions yet. Make your first investment to see activity.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Profile complete. Your plan is ready.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Learn My Risk
2. Complete KYC
3. Start My SIP
4. Review Plan
5. View Portfolio
6. Confirm Details
7. Update Risk Profile
8. Track Progress
